snippet.title: Revenge of the Savage Planet - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
A new trailer for upbeat, satirical, action-adventure sci-fi Revenge of the Savage Planet was shown during the FGS Live From gamescom latam showcase. ‘The wait is almost over’ pre Early Access trailer shows off a variety of the game’s locations.Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets. Launching May 8, 2025 on PC, Xbox and PS5.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
